items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I took Chris Potter over there with me and Terry Clarke and everything

ctx.x: I guess the… I was thinking about Europe, of course, and Denmark. And I… years ago I got this… the Danish Jazz Par Award, which was a nice chunk of money. And I could do some writing. I took Chris Potter over there with me and Terry Clarke and everything, and I got to write for a string quartet and… and I found out the sponsor was the Danish cigarette company. And you had just been hospitalized with cancer, right?
